notes: Ruled 2026-11-17 (kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-17-rulings-pb5789-folios.md) against the printed folios transcribed from the GovInfo scan (kb/Work PB5789); PARTIAL then on kb/Work PB5894 and PB5895, both fixed (DialectBehavior.SumAdditionsInDependencyOrder, VCR row 7.87). CONFORMS. Rolling forward (b), subtotalling with and without UPON (c) and crossfooting (a) run at 85 (1985-GR-XIII_3_19_4-9, g85_bf09_09). Crossfooting is performed 'according to the sequence in which sum counters are defined within the control footing report group' (ReportWriterEmitter.RegisterInDefinitionOrder: counter by counter in counter-id order, each addend read as it stands then, rolling forward after, per XIII.3.20.4 GR10 a/b): pb5894_crossfoot_in_definition_order_85 prints SA = SB (0) + SC = 3, T3 = 0, W = 9 over four addends, and the rolled FINAL totals 7 and 0. A counter that is its own addend is legal at 85 (the SR4e refusal, ScreenRolledChains, runs only from 2002) and adds 'the initial value of that sum counter at the time of summation': all of a counter's crossfoot addends are one addition whose closure reads them before it stores, so S5 SUM WS-A S5 gives 6, X SUM Y X RESET ON FINAL 3 then 10, Z SUM Z Y Z 3 then 13, and the mutual P SUM Q / Q SUM WS-A P gives 3 and 6 (pb5895_sum_counter_its_own_addend_85). Every expected value derived from GR9a and GR10 before the run.
